name: opencode-session-reflection
description: Turn OpenCode session failures into reusable reliability improvements.

scripts.check:import: node -e "import('./src/index.js').then((m) => { const d = m.default; if (typeof d?.id !== 'string' || typeof d.server !== 'function' || typeof d.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('default export must be a plugin module with id, server() and setup()'); console.log('plugin import ok') })"
